notes.title: Eureka Is Now Available!
notes.notes:
Hi Everyone!

It's finally time. Eureka is now available to download and play!

Remember, this game is still early in development, so community feedback is extremely helpful. If you have any bug reports or feature suggestions, please post them in the appropriate sub-forums [url=https://steamcommunity.com/app/2163860/discussions/]here[/url].

Thanks so much!

notes.title: New Release Date
notes.notes:
Hi everyone!

First off, big thanks to all of you who've followed and added Eureka to your wishlist. It means a lot to see people getting excited about my game!

Unfortunately, things are taking just a little longer than expected, so I had to push the release date back one week. That should give me enough time to finish what I want to finish before release. Hopefully it will be worth the wait.

So the new release date is [b]Friday, October 21st[/b]. I look forward to hearing what you guys think. See you all next week!
